svg.title: Long prompt: a row open with a 61-line prompt scrolling inside its box, and the same row collapsed
svg.desc: A: the writer row open in the team panel. The prompt spans the row's full width, has grown to its 24-line limit and scrolls inside the box; lines 14 to 37 of 61 are in view, with a scrollbar. Settings sit under the prompt in two columns. B: the same row collapsed, one line: dot, name, badges and the description cut with an ellipsis, no prompt text. Light theme, existing tokens.

g.text: - Start from the brief the editor set: who reads it,
and what they need to do after reading.
- Outline first, as headings and one line each.
- Draft section by section. Short sentences.
- Put the answer first, the reasons after.
- Source every fact with a link the fact-checker
- Use the reader's words. Explain a term once.
- The draft, in the file the editor named.
- The claims you could not source.
- Open questions for the editor, one line each.
- If the brief is unclear, ask the editor one
- If two sources disagree, keep both and say so.
- If the piece is too long, cut it.

Knowledge, where it runs and a taller prompt editor:
Open writer's page
1 · The prompt spans the row (changed from pass 1)
Pass 1 put the prompt in the left column, 296px: about 36 characters a line,
so a long prompt wrapped into a ribbon. Now the open row is: Name and
Description side by side, the Prompt the full row width (about 70 characters,
close to the agent page's), then the settings in two columns. Tab order is
the reading order: Name, Description, Prompt, Colour, column, Engine, Model,
Policy profile. All pass-2 drawings use this layout.
2 · Grows, then scrolls inside the box
The existing CodeViewer (Monaco, markdown, word wrap on, line numbers),
minHeight 180 (8 lines), maxHeight 500 (24 lines). Past that the box scrolls
and its scrollbar shows; the panel body scrolls only once the box is at its
end (Monaco's alwaysConsumeMouseWheel: false), so the wheel never traps.
Wrapped lines carry no number, so "61 lines" counts real lines. The count
and "changed" sit beside the label, in text.
3 · Keyboard: Tab leaves the box
In the panel the editor runs with tabFocusMode on, so Tab and Shift+Tab move
between fields instead of typing a tab (no keyboard trap, WCAG 2.1.2). The hint
says so. Esc inside the box first closes Monaco's own widgets; only an Esc
with none open reaches the panel (which asks before closing).
4 · Settings under the prompt
Two columns: Colour | Its work counts as; Engine + Model | Policy profile.
The colour group wraps to two lines of swatches when narrow.
5 · A taller editor on the agent's own page
Edit team only: "Open writer's page" goes to /agents/writer, where the
prompt editor is 360 to 2000px tall. With unsaved changes it asks first
(states-unsaved-and-replace.svg). In New team the line reads "Knowledge and
where it runs: on its own page, once the team is created."
No length limit in the UI
The server's limit, if any, comes back as a field error under the box like any
other ("This prompt is too long: at most N characters." [server]).
B · THE SAME ROW COLLAPSED
writer
edited

6 · Collapsed: one line, whatever the prompt's length
Dot, name, badges ("edited" here: its prompt changed), then the description
on one line, cut with an ellipsis (CSS truncate; the full line is in the open
row, not in a tooltip). No prompt text when collapsed, so a 61-line prompt
costs the list nothing. Collapsing keeps the box's scroll place and any edits.
Rows stay 52px whatever the description; a long name pushes the description
out first, then truncates itself (names are at most 31 characters).
